description: This file contains Bash shell script functions related to managing authentication directories and files for Docker containers in the 'openclaw' project. It includes utilities for trimming strings, normalizing directory paths, selecting auth directories/files based on providers, collecting auth info from CSVs or overrides, and joining CSV strings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from both ends of a string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Removes leading dots and trims whitespace from a directory path, then prepends a dot.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth directory based on provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth filename based on provider name.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects auth directories from a CSV string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth directories based on override variable or default.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Aggregates auth directories, prioritizing override over default list.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects auth files from a CSV string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth files based on override variable or default list.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Aggregates auth files, prioritizing override over default list.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple strings into a single CSV line.
